The crime lieutenant [[Abron Mar]] owned an '''R-41 Starchaser'''. He used it to fly in between [[Takara's stronghold]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katraasii]]. While being chased by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], Mar would have used his [[R-41 Starchaser]] to escape the [[Katraasii Spaceport]], but Jade had sealed the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] that Mar had parked his ship in. As a result, Mar decided to lay a trap for Jade instead of escape.
